name: Open a Restaurant!

pick.label: Pick a brand
pick.heading: Pick a brand and open its restaurant
lead: Brands love to wander into new territory. Furniture shops sell meatballs, car makers run cafés, and toy companies open theme parks. Sometimes it works brilliantly. Sometimes it’s just weird.
Choose a famous brand that has nothing to do with food and open its first restaurant. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *The worse the fit, the better.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: This is just for a bit of fun, not a business plan. Some of these restaurants would be a hit, and some would be closed by Friday. Both are welcome.

rows: Which brand is opening a restaurant?
The one thing everybody orders. What is it, and what’s it called?
The furniture, the music, the uniforms, the smell…
Who goes there? Fans of the brand, people who have never heard of it, tourists, someone else?
The thing that makes it unmissable:
A gimmick, a rule, a mascot, something people will put on Instagram…

values.name: Verspätung. Platform 1, Friedrichshain.
values.dish: Currywurst, announced for 19:04, expected 19:27, and then served at a different table from the one it was announced for.
values.look: Exactly like the restaurant car on an ICE, including the one table that is reserved all evening for nobody.
values.who: Anybody who has ever stood on a platform in Hanover in the rain, which is most of Germany.
values.twist: If your food is more than an hour late, you get 25 per cent of your money back, after filling in a form.

yours.label: Your restaurant
yours.heading: Your idea
yours.lead: Fill it in on your own phone or laptop (it stays on your device), and be ready to tell the class about your restaurant in a few sentences.

rank.label: The ranking
rank.heading: Which restaurant wins?
rank.lead: Each student tells us about their restaurant in a few sentences. Add it, then argue it into place until everybody agrees.
